notes: Reliability update: the friends and sharing server moved to a new address, so admin panel changes reach the launcher immediately. When the crash screen reports a missing dependency the launcher installs the required mods itself. Mod incompatibility warnings show clear findings instead of the raw log. CurseForge was removed; Discover uses Modrinth only. The broken desktop shortcut created after updating is fixed, and the admin panel labels premium and cracked accounts separately.
